opportunities.title: International Payroll Analyst
opportunities.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ y

opportunities.description: Marketing & AI Intern Thermeleon | Internship | The Netherlands About Thermeleon Thermeleon is a technology-driven company working at the intersection of energy, technology and sustainable horticulture. We develop innovative solutions that contribute to a more sustainable greenhouse industry while helping reduce pressure on the electricity grid. We are a growing team with big ambitions, and we're looking for someone who wants to help shape how Thermeleon presents itself to the world. The role We're looking for a creative, proactive and tech-savvy Marketing Intern who wants to take ownership and build things from the ground up. You'll work on refreshing our brand, developing marketing materials and building our digital marketing infrastructure using modern AI tools such as Claude Code. You'll have the opportunity to combine creativity, marketing strategy and technology, while seeing your work directly impact a growing company. What you'll be working on 1. Brand Refresh Help refine and strengthen the Thermeleon brand identity. Develop a consistent visual and communication style. Translate our brand positioning into a compelling brand experience. 2. Marketing Materials Update and develop our marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers and other sales collateral. Create visual content for internal and external communication. Ensure consistency across all marketing touchpoints. 3. Build the Thermeleon Website with Claude Code Take part in rebuilding and developing the Thermeleon website using Claude Code. Translate ideas and designs into functional web pages. Improve website structure, user experience and content. Explore how AI can accelerate website development. 4. Build a Content Marketing Machine with Claude Code Help build a scalable content marketing system using AI. Develop workflows for content creation, planning and distribution. Create a content calendar and establish a consistent publishing rhythm. Explore AI-powered tools and automations to make marketing more efficient. Who we're looking for You're studying Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Digital Media, or a related field. You're creative, curious and entrepreneurial. You have an interest in AI, technology and digital tools. You're excited about experimenting with tools like Claude Code (coding experience is a plus, but not a requirement). You have an eye for design, branding and visual communication. You take initiative and enjoy turning ideas into reality. You're comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects. You have excellent communication skills in English. Speaking Dutch is a plus What we offer A hands-on internship where you'll have real ownership and responsibility. The opportunity to build the marketing foundation of a growing technology company. Freedom to experiment with AI and emerging technologies. A close-knit, ambitious and international team. Plenty of room to learn, experiment and bring your own ideas to life. An internship compensation of €400 per month. Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. Your role You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners.
